scope: Read-only project shared state, session and visit ownership, exact frozen origin navigation, project observation compatibility, build and language regressions.
checks: Independent read-only panel consumes admitted observation snapshots and has no game mutation or network port.
Project protocol 1 remains hidden; project protocol 2 supports child protocol 1 and distinguishes absent state from a supported empty revision 0.
Scene visits preserve state filtering and past origins; a new task resets state and filtering.
State keys and JSON values, including false, zero, Chinese, Japanese, emoji and markup, render as literal text.
Per-key revision and the last deletion remain visible; deletion does not fabricate a current value.
Source navigation uses origin.source from the frozen behavior declaration rather than the actor definition or current scene.
Source tickets bind task, build, snapshot, current visit, state revision and record identity; dirty and creating editor states block delayed navigation.
An admitted source read survives its own loading busy state; initial and duplicate busy clicks remain blocked.
Equivalent polling and language changes preserve focus, filter text and caret without execution commands.
Dedicated responsive CSS stacks rows below 600px; actual 390px layout is tested separately in Chrome.
Product JavaScript syntax and git diff --check passed.
limits: DOM-controller tests use the real engine query for host admission; real runtime, browser screenshots and relocated ZIP execution are separate evidence.
These 82 tests include the previous 67 UI/language checks; incremental and historical counts must not be summed.
Current frozen origin.source has document and property provenance without a sourceRange, so the UI promises document navigation only.
